trending.title: How we ran the Kiro University Challenge as a community build-along: 141 builders at AWS User Group Madurai
trending.description: A community case study and playbook from AWS User Group Madurai. We - Vivek, Logesh and Poobalan turned Kiro's seven-lesson University Challenge into a build-along with four evening Circle sessions, a one-command setup that created a compliant repo and progress tracking, a leaderboard ranked by active days, and community rewards earned by rank. 141 members joined, 77 linked a repo, 38 demonstrated all seven lessons.
